lines.speaker: Mira of the Tides
lines.text: Oh, you're back. I was updating the map. The Drowned Vaults shifted again — third time this week.

lines.speaker: Mira of the Tides
lines.text: I breathe water now. I barely notice anymore. You get used to it, mostly.

lines.speaker: Mira of the Tides
lines.text: The secret passages I've charted don't stay secret for long. The dungeon... corrects itself.

lines.speaker: Mira of the Tides
lines.text: There are things below Floor Nine that I've mapped but can't explain. I've stopped trying.

lines.speaker: Mira of the Tides
lines.text: Come back in one piece. I need a good source. You're the only one still going down there voluntarily.
